status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 41% fewer than the week before, most of them in Darfur, Khartoum and Kordofan.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 41 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Darfur, Khartoum og Kordofan.

summary.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have seized Al-Khuwai in West Kordofan and are pushing toward Al-Nahud while the Rapid Support Forces continue drone strikes on civilian areas and power stations, leaving cities without electricity. Humanitarian assistance is deteriorating, with food aid cut for 900,000 people and drought and war driving Darfur and Kordofan toward famine. A Rapid Support Forces field commander has defected to the Sudanese army, a former RSF adviser was released in Chad after 13 months, and a former Sudanese information minister was attacked by armed men in Uganda. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren (SAF) har erobret Al-Khuwai i Vest-Kordofan og presser mot Al-Nahud, mens RSF-militsen fortsetter droneangrep på sivile områder og kraftverk, noe som etterlater byer uten strøm. Humanitær hjelp forverres, med matforsyning kuttet for 900 000 personer, og tørke og krig driver Darfur og Kordofan mot hungersnød. En feltkommandør i RSF har gått over til hæren, en tidligere RSF-rådgiver ble løslatt i Tsjad etter 13 måneder, og en tidligere sudansk informasjonsminister ble angrepet av væpnede menn i Uganda. 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
